import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter out near-duplicates based on correlation
    keep_ids = set()
    correlated_pairs = set()
    
    # Build correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    
    # Identify near-duplicates (|r| >= 0.6)
    for i in range(len(feats.ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(feats.ids)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                correlated_pairs.add((feats.ids[i], feats.ids[j]))
    
    # Keep only one from each correlated pair
    used = set()
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        if a not in used and b not in used:
            # Prefer the one with higher absolute t-statistic
            idx_a = feats.column(a)
            idx_b = feats.column(b)
            t_a = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1,idx_a], feats.x[feats.y==0,idx_a]).statistic)
            t_b = abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1,idx_b], feats.x[feats.y==0,idx_b]).statistic)
            keep_ids.add(a if t_a > t_b else b)
            used.add(a)
            used.add(b)
    
    # Add remaining features
    remaining_ids = set(feats.ids) - used
    keep_ids.update(remaining_ids)
    
    # Calculate effect sizes and select top candidates
    effects = []
    for fid in keep_ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        y0_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])
        y1_mean = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx])
        effect_size = y1_mean - y0_mean
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1,col_idx], feats.x[feats.y==0,col_idx]).statistic
        effects.append((fid, abs(effect_size), abs(t_stat)))
    
    # Sort by effect size (descending)
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top drivers (max 4 as per checker report)
    drivers = [fid for fid, _, _ in effects[:4]]
    
    # For columns, include only top 5 significant features
    columns = [fid for fid, _, t in effects if t > 1.5][:5]
    
    # Check for interaction terms (products) - limit to 2 interactions max
    products = []
    for i, (a, _, _) in enumerate(effects):
        for j in range(i+1, min(len(effects), 5)):  # Limit search space
            b, _, _ = effects[j]
            # Check if they're not correlated
            if (a, b) not in correlated_pairs and (b, a) not in correlated_pairs:
                # Test interaction term
                interaction = feats.x[:, feats.column(a)] * feats.x[:, feats.column(b)]
                t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(interaction[feats.y==1], interaction[feats.y==0]).statistic
                if abs(t_stat) > 1.5:
                    products.append((a, b))
                    if len(products) >= 2:  # Limit to 2 products
                        break
        if len(products) >= 2:
            break
    
    # Weighted score: use top 3 features with highest effect sizes
    loadings = {}
    for i, (fid, _, _) in enumerate(effects[:3]):
        loadings[fid] = 1.0 / (i + 1)  # Inverse rank weighting
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
